text: Developing a mobile app requires careful planning. First, designers focus on responsive design, ensuring the interface adapts smoothly to different screen sizes and orientations. A key decision is choosing between native development, which offers optimal performance and deep device integration, and cross-platform tools, which save time by using a single codebase for both iOS and Android. Once the app is built, developers submit it to app stores, where it must pass review guidelines before going live. Finally, rigorous testing is essential, as users quickly abandon apps that lag or crash, so optimizing speed and stability is just as important as the features themselves.
